reorderRules.title: Reorder rules
reorderRules.description: Tell the scan when each item needs restocking: the level that triggers a reorder and how much to order.
reorderRules.empty: No reorder rules yet. Add one so low-stock items show up as reorder suggestions.
reorderRules.deleteConsequence: The item stops being checked against this rule. Stock and purchase orders are not changed.
reorderRules.deleteFailed: Could not delete the rule. Try again.

form.minQty: Reorder when stock is at or below
form.invalid: Pick a product and enter whole numbers (quantity to order at least 1).
form.duplicate: This item already has a reorder rule. Edit the existing one.
form.saveFailed: Could not save the rule. Try again.
